title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A 3 by 3 board of square tiles seen from the front and above. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left (front-left) square; a raised orange disc marks the goal on the top-right (back-right) square. Up moves the token away from the viewer, Down toward, Left and Right sideways. Hint shows a green arrow from the token toward a square one step closer to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Press Hint to see a move that brings the token one step closer. The shortest route takes 4 moves: 2 up and 2 right, in any order.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means away from the starting camera view (toward the back row); the arrow keys and WASD also move the token.
The start and goal never change; the board has no walls, so the hint simply points toward the goal (up first, then right).
